name: Jewel Changi Airport
slides: Jewel Changi Airport at a glance
The HSBC Rain Vortex falls 40 metres from a hole in the glass roof: the world's tallest indoor waterfall, up to 37,850 litres a minute.
At night it gets a show →
In the evening a 360-degree light and sound show is projected onto the falling water.
The Shiseido Forest Valley climbs five storeys around the shops, with around 3,000 trees and 60,000 shrubs.
Up top, you walk on nets →
A bouncing net under the roof
Canopy Park has Singapore's largest hedge maze and a 250-metre Bouncing Net. The Canopy Bridge, glass-floored in the middle, hangs 23 metres above the ground.

caption:
The Singapore airport mall with the world's tallest indoor waterfall 🇸🇬

At Jewel Changi Airport the HSBC Rain Vortex drops 40 metres through a hole in the glass roof. Around it rise a five-storey forest and about 300 shops and restaurants. After dark the water becomes a light show.

Would you get to the airport early just for this? 👇
